newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to detail reforms still pending in Jan - Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain to detail reforms still pending in Jan - Rato.

text.p: The Spanish government will publish in January a dossier on structural reforms which are still pending, Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Monday.
"(The government) is elaborating a dossier of which measures still have to be taken. And we hope to have it done by January," Rato told reporters.
Among the structural reforms the government may approve measure to change the labour market and the public sector.
